<!--
  An editor file tab (40 px high): a file icon, the label and a close button. `preview` marks a tab that is not
  pinned yet. Keyboard (Enter and Space activate, Delete closes) is the programmer's behind the click and close
  events.
-->
<script lang="ts" module>
  import type { Snippet } from "svelte";

  export type EditorTabProps = {
    label: string;
    closeLabel: string;
    active?: boolean;
    preview?: boolean;
    class?: string;
    icon?: Snippet;
    onclick?: () => void;
    onclose?: () => void;
  };
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import Box from "../primitives/box/box.svelte";
  import Button from "../primitives/button/button.svelte";
  import Inline from "../primitives/inline/inline.svelte";
  import LucideIcon from "../primitives/lucide-icon/lucide-icon.svelte";
  import { cn } from "../utils";

  let {
    label,
    closeLabel,
    active = false,
    preview = false,
    class: className,
    icon,
    onclick,
    onclose,
  }: EditorTabProps = $props();
</script>

<Box
  class={cn(
    "flex h-10 shrink-0 cursor-pointer flex-col justify-center data-[state=active]:bg-card " +
      "[&_svg]:text-muted-foreground",
    "border-r border-border",
    className
  )}
  role="tab"
  aria-selected={active}
  tabindex={(active ? 0 : -1)}
  data-slot="editor-tab"
  data-state={(active ? "active" : "default")}
  onclick={() => onclick?.()}
>
  <Inline class="flex h-10 items-center gap-2 px-3" data-slot="editor-tab-content">
    {@render icon?.()}
    <Inline
      class={cn("text-xs text-foreground", (preview ? "font-semibold italic" : "font-bold"))}
      data-slot="editor-tab-label"
    >
      {label}
    </Inline>
    <Button
      variant="ghost"
      size="sm"
      layout="icon"
      class={"p-0 [&>svg]:size-4"}
      aria-label={closeLabel}
      tabindex={-1}
      data-slot="editor-tab-close"
      onclick={() => onclose?.()}
    >
      <LucideIcon name="x" size={16} />
    </Button>
  </Inline>
</Box>
